replies.author: Hacktivism
replies.body:
Alright, I'm gonna give my honest opinion. Keep in mind that this is meant to be constructive criticism to help you improve, and not to insult you or your map in any way.

To start off, this seems like a pretty flat map, with the exception of the hills on either side, and the occasional tree or structure. I'd suggest adding a bit more detail to it. Simply adding some grass or flowers to the ground makes a huge difference!

I don't really see the point in the extra fences, or the wheat fields. If they're for decoration, try adding some more detail to them. Same goes for the buildings and the tree/log area surrounded by leaves. Using logs on the ground typically isn't aesthetically pleasing, so try changing it up. Add more block variation!

From what I can tell, the monument block is on the wall of the spawn. It'd be pretty hard to set up spawn protection that way, and the resistance effects that players spawn with would give them a huge advantage while defending. Also, try adding more detail to both the interior and exterior of the spawn building. It seems a bit bland and plain right now, but definitely has potential.

In my opinion, full iron armor and an enchanted sword would be way too powerful for this map, and would pretty much ruin gameplay. Maybe change it to just a leather chestplate? I'd say, at most, go with full leather armor and a stone sword.

Overall, the map looks very blocky and unnaturally shaped, which is what you don't want in a map with hills and water. Try rounding out the hills a bit; they look very stiff and manmade. Maybe round out the corners of the map, or add an outline of some sort.

It's good for a first map, and the map definitely has potential, so keep improving!

replies.author: halfrest
replies.body:
I'm no map developer, but I'm going to give my opinion. I have been on build teams and etc. so I do have alot of experience on the subject.

This map is very flat. Of course you could say there should be some flat terrain for fighting on, but you put it right outside a spawn and as you can see in maps on Avicus today, if there's a flat area, it still has some variation in it (slightly sloping terrain, etc.) that really brings out the detail in the map.

Second of all is the lack of detail in the map. The whole entire terrain part is all consisted of grass, and because of that it doesn't look natural and it lacks a good design. 

Third of all is the rectangular shape of the map. On large terrain maps you should VERY RARELY actually be hit off the map. This map is thin and it lacks some kind of boundary on the side that blends in with the terrain (like trees for example). Because of it's shape, it doesn't say "CREATIVITY" just like other maps do.

replies.author: steven5703
replies.body:
Sorry! :(

We're sorry to announce that your map has been denied for testing on the Avicus Network. The reasons are the following:

-Try adding block variation and hills to make pvp and gameplay more interesting.

-The map is not very aesthetically pleasing and plain. Try adding details to the buildings

-The positioning of the monument is awkward. Try moving the monument to the center of the room, or to a completely new area.

You may rework your map and update it so we can re-evaluate it. Please use only one forum submission per map, update this thread once you're done. Good luck!

Overall Score:
Gameplay: 5/10
Aesthetics: 3/10
Creativity: 4/10

Thanks for your map submission! :D
